mapper.select: SELECT a.bmt20_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id , a.bmt20_info_id AS info_id , a.bmt20_appr_id AS appr_id , b.apr01_reg_date::date AS reg_date , b.apr01_title AS title FROM bmt20_relate_appr a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.bmt20_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.bmt20_info_id = #{infoId} AND a.bmt20_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bmt20_relate_appr ( bmt20_relate_appr_id, bmt20_company_id, bmt20_info_id, bmt20_appr_id ) VALUES ( #{relateApprId}, #{companyId}, #{infoId}, #{apprId} )
